scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.build.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.build.yml build && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.build.yml up -d --force-recreate
scripts.docker:dev:rebuild: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.build.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build --force-recreate
